meta.title: Lease Loop – catalogue
meta.description: Lease an e-bike, laptop or farm machine. When the lease ends, it gets a second life.
brand.name: Lease Loop
brand.tagline: Circular leasing for e-bikes, laptops and farm machines
catalogue.title: Catalogue
catalogue.intro: Every item can be leased, returned, refurbished and leased again.
catalogue.empty: No assets in the database yet. Run npm run db:setup and reload.

invoices.title: Monthly invoice schedule
invoices.intro: Each monthly invoice locks the agreed net rent ({netRent}). VAT is calculated according to the statutory rate in effect on each invoice's due date.
invoices.pageIntro: Your lease contract is signed and the monthly net rent is locked for the full term.
invoices.bill.heading: Lease invoice
invoices.bill.vatChangeNote: Statutory VAT changed from {signingRate}% (at signing) to {currentRate}% on {dueDate}. Your net monthly rent ({netRent}) remains locked.
apply.title: Apply for a lease
apply.intro: Answer a few questions. We only ask what we need for this lease.
apply.deal.heading: Your lease
apply.questions.heading: Your details
apply.money.hint: Amount in euros, for example 2500 or 2500,50
apply.money.invalid: Enter an amount in euros, for example 2500 or 2500,50.
apply.date.invalid: Enter a real date as day/month/year, for example 31/12/1990.
apply.dropped: We removed answers that no longer apply:
apply.error: We could not check your answers. Try again in a moment.
apply.notFound: We could not find that item.
apply.invalidDeal: This lease is not valid. Pick an item, a term and a down payment again.
apply.unavailable: This item cannot be leased right now.
apply.signError: We could not sign the contract right now. Please try again.
decision.heading: Result
decision.incomplete.title: Keep going
decision.yes.title: Approved
decision.yes.body: You meet all the requirements for this lease.
decision.no.title: We can't offer this lease
decision.manual_review.title: A person will check your application
decision.manual_review.body: We can't approve this automatically. Here is why:
reason.min_age: You need to be {minimum} to sign a lease, and you are {age} for now. Come back when you turn {minimum}, or ask a parent or guardian to apply instead.
reason.residency: We only lease to people who live in Finland, Sweden or Estonia.
reason.affordability: The monthly rent of {rent} is more than 30 % of your monthly net income ({income}). A longer term or a bigger down payment may help.
reason.business_id: The business ID {answer} is not valid. Check the number, including the digit after the dash.
reason.financed_limits.below_minimum: The financed amount is below the smallest amount we finance. Choose a smaller down payment or a pricier item.
reason.financed_limits.above_maximum: The financed amount is above the largest amount we finance. Choose a bigger down payment.
reason.financed_limits.unknown_term: This term is not available for this financed amount.
reason.pep_manual_review: Anti-money-laundering rules require a person to check every application from a politically exposed person.
reason.signatory_required: The person applying must be allowed to sign for the company. A person will contact the colleague who can sign.
reason.blocked_answer: One of your answers means we cannot offer this lease.
